section.p: Result: If valid internal anchor links are present and resolve to a heading ID in the HTML package, the converter maps the href to the corresponding generated .dita topic file. If the anchor target cannot be resolved, the converter retains only the visible link text as plain text and flags the broken reference in the conversion report.
